validated_results.title: The Diverse Forms of Lactose Intolerance and the Putative Linkage to Several Cancers.
validated_results.reason: The same narrative review summarizes literature on lactase persistence phenotypes and cancer incidence without presenting original primary study results.

validated_results.title: Dietary fiber, whole grains, carbohydrate, glycemic index, and glycemic load in relation to risk of prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Dietary fiber, whole grains, carbohydrate, glycemic index, and glycemic load in relation to risk of prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: The whole-grain estimate comes from a pooled "systematic review and meta-analysis" of previously published studies rather than primary data collection.

validated_results.title: Effect of Carotene and Lycopene on the Risk of Prostate Cancer: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Observational Studies.
validated_results.reason: The abstract reports "We conducted a systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis" summarizing 34 eligible studies, so it is a review publication.

validated_results.title: Effect of Carotene and Lycopene on the Risk of Prostate Cancer: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Observational Studies.
validated_results.reason: Lycopene risk ratios are pooled summary estimates from a "systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of observational studies", not original human study results.

validated_results.title: Obesity and cancer: mechanistic insights from transdisciplinary studies.
validated_results.reason: The article is a narrative review that "summarize[s] epidemiologic and preclinical evidence" on obesity, weight loss, and cancer rather than reporting an original human analysis.

validated_results.title: Nocturnal light pollution and underexposure to daytime sunlight: Complementary mechanisms of circadian disruption and related diseases.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review of past epidemiologic studies on artificial light at night, melatonin suppression, and disease risk without original primary data.

validated_results.title: Nocturnal light pollution and underexposure to daytime sunlight: Complementary mechanisms of circadian disruption and related diseases.
validated_results.reason: Vitamin D content is discussed within a narrative review of "past epidemiologic studies" on sunlight and light pollution, providing no original human study estimate.
